attorneys: Chambers v. Florida, ante, p. 227. Mr. Leon A. Ransom for petitioner., Messrs. Thomas S. Lawson, Attorney General of Alabama, and William H. Loeb, Assistant Attorney General, for respondent.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam:

Motion for leave to proceed in forma pauperis, and petition for writ of certiorari, granted. The judgment is reversed.
